node.statement: Availability correction (challenge ch-5031992bb44865d2): the unit and norm estimates are not presently derivable from validated nodes 1.3.2 and 1.4 alone. Their indispensable (1,1) premise is d_11,n=h_11,n v_n-mu_11,n with ||d_11,n(X)||<=kappa*e*||X||, supplied only by node 1.5.1 and ultimately by node 1.3. Therefore this bridge yields no unit, norm, bijectivity, or fixed-amplification conclusion until nodes 1.3 and 1.5.1 are validated. After those validations, node 1.5.1 supplies the comparison at every n for the same level-one maps, and the conditional triangle-inequality argument in node 1.5.3.1 applies using validated nodes 1.3.2 and 1.4. No permitted external input replaces the missing comparison.
